items.html: For in the first head, the inner light is the name: Yod-He-Vav-He [Yod, Hey, Vav, Hey]. And only its four simple letters are vocalized, like this: a Cholam on the Yod, a Tzere on the Hey, a Kamatz on the Vav, and a Tzere on the Hey. And this vocalization is according to the movement of the letters, as is known in the books of the Kabbalists.
